## Summary

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] Follows branch naming convention (`feature/*`, `fix/*`, `chore/*`)
- [ ] Uses conventional commit style
- [ ] `flutter analyze` passes
- [ ] `flutter test` passes
- [ ] App builds locally (`flutter build apk --debug` at minimum)
- [ ] No debug logs / commented dead code introduced
- [ ] No secrets or credentials in code/config
- [ ] README updated (if behavior/setup changed)
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes

## Testing Notes

List manual and automated testing performed.

## Risks & Rollback

Mention risks and rollback strategy if needed.
